info.name: PyTodo Pro - Week 4 Web and API
info.description:
Week 4 test suite for PyTodo Pro.

How to run:
1. Start the app (python -B ../../app.py) on a fresh database (delete pytodo_pro.db first).
2. Import this collection and PyTodo_Local.postman_environment.json; select the 'PyTodo Local' environment.
3. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner, in order, 1 iteration.

Postman keeps the login cookie between requests. SETUP requests register or log in a user, which switches who the following requests run as. Requests with 'Disable cookie jar' run as a logged-out visitor.

Each check is named after the EXPECTED behaviour. A failing check means the app did something else: investigate it, then log a defect. SETUP requests only prepare data.
